method: Read-only binary inspection and production CUA search interactions; owned SwiftUI color/spring/symbol probes and disposable Zen profile checks. No production instrumentation.

behavior.query: CUA observed that surrounding whitespace remains in the no-results message and prevents an otherwise matching speedometer query from matching. Downloads therefore preserves the raw query.

layout.title: 17pt semibold, Color.primary; 0x10271f634 / 0x10271f670 / 0x10271f6b8
layout.subtitle: 14pt regular, GrayA11, centered multiline, maximum width 270pt; 0x10271f7d0 / 0x10271f828 / 0x10271f870 / 0x10271f8ac

entrance.translation: Spring response .35s, damping fraction .6, blend duration 0 at 0x10271fc4c–0x10271fc68; target y=0 in 0x10271fcdc
entrance.sampling: EmptySpring.swift independently samples the public native Spring over its .8702308868566827s settling duration; CSS linear() interpolates 121 samples. Reduced motion omits the animation.

placeholder.control: Native SwiftUI TextField at 0x102729dd4, PlainTextFieldStyle at 0x102729140; parent uses 14pt medium and GrayA11.
placeholder.probe: FieldReference.swift creates the corresponding owned NSHostingView. Its native AppKitTextField uses NSColor.placeholderTextColor: black/Aqua or white/Dark with alpha 63/255. Zen now uses this value directly.
placeholder.qualification: Native default-color inference, not a pixel comparison of actual Arc placeholder glyphs.

limits: CSS spring samples approximate native motion; physical entrance frames have not been compared.
Symbol masks were rendered at 2x; other display scales remain unverified.
Search debounce and filter transitions still need exact timing checks.
Continuous corners, remaining Library chrome, physical hover, full parity and browser-wide speed superiority remain unproven.
